_comment: Three-kernel 3D render target (AAA: PBR + IBL + bloom). OFF by default — flipping enabled:true routes 3D genres to the AAA kernel instead of the from-scratch engine. DO NOT enable until validated with a nightly run (see pipeline/engine/AAA_HANDOFF.md for the exact claude -p validation command). Naively disabling the from-scratch engine would send 3D to Phaser — use THIS flag instead.
